title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
blurb: Introduced attention to neural translation: the decoder computes a fresh weighted average of all encoder states at every output step.
intro: A bidirectional RNN encoder produces one annotation per source word. At each output step a small network scores every annotation against the previous decoder state, the softmax of the scores weights the annotations into a context vector, and the decoder consumes it together with the previous word. The steps build the GRU, the encoder-decoder and additive attention; the capstone wires the full teacher-forced model and returns the alignment matrix.
